findings.title: Raw CPI without account owner verification in file
findings.fix: Verify `account.to_account_info().owner == &expected_program` before every invoke, or use Anchor CPI crates.

findings.title: invoke() with program/instruction from accounts (arbitrary CPI)
findings.fix: Hardcode expected program IDs (`declare_id!`/static Pubkey) and validate `program.key() == EXPECTED` before CPI.

findings.title: UncheckedAccount used without Signer/validation in instruction
findings.fix: Replace with `Signer<'info>` or `Account<'info, T>` and add `#[account(...)]` constraints; never trust UncheckedAccount.

findings.title: Raw AccountInfo field - no owner/type validation enforced by deserialization
findings.fix: Use `Account<'info, T>` / `Program<'info, T>` types, or manually check `.owner == expected_program_id` and `.key()`.
